title: Pay as chorus girl, ballad singer and blues singer
summary: She earned about $10.50 a week as a chorus girl and $13 as a ballad singer, and says she only learned to sing the blues when records came out.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Uh-huh. And do you remember how much you got paid for that work?
Well, if you did a solo, if you were a blues singer, you got good pay. If you was a chorus girl, you got around 10.50 a week and if you did ballads, you got about maybe $12.00 a week.
Well, you were billed as a blues singer, weren't you?
No, I was a ballad singer.
At first, I was nothing but a chorus girl, 10.50 a week.
Uh-huh. And then when you were billed as a ballad singer, how much were you making?
About twelve and a half or $13.00 a week.
Uh-huh. And now how much did you make as a blues singer?
I never did sing as a blues singer.
I never started to blues sing until I left the records and started singing in the cabarets and things. Then (unintelligible) O.K. records.
Didn't you consider yourself a blues singer when you were making the records?
I didn't know how to sing the blues. Didn't know how to sing the blues, (inaudible).
When did you learn how to sing the blues?
I learned how to sing them record come out.
